item.title: Not cleaned despite being told it would be, 24th August
item.description:
A week ago I reported a strong urine odour and urine stains at the wilton road end of the alleyway. This is due to the council/police not dealing with the large groups of men who hang around outside the betting shop and use the alleyway as a toilet. A week ago, the status was immediately set to ‘fixed’ and I was told it would be cleaned as part of the ‘weekly’ cleanse. The truth is the greenwich side of wilton road and the end of the alleyway is not cleaned weekly, it hasn’t been done in months. Proof is that it has not been cleaned this last week!! It is disgusting, it is a health and safety issue if kids drop into the urine and it smells disgusting. DO NOT MARK THIS AS FIXED - IT IS NOT FIXED AS OF TODAY.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Abbey Grove, Abbey Wood

item.title: Replace speed control measures on Adelaide Avenue, 24th August
item.description:
The speed bumps and other traffic calming measures on Adelaide Avenue are wholly inadequate and do nothing to control the speed of traffic through the area. On Saturday night (August 22nd) a car left the road and collided with the black car in the uploaded photos, which in turn pushed the white car into street furniture. This is extremely concerning and the residents of this area are shocked that the Council does nothing to address the problem. We have repeatedly contacted the Council to address the problem with no results. Speed bumps installed in 2023 are pathetically inadequate. Please install credible and effective speed control measures as a matter of urgency.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 73, Adelaide Avenue, Ladywell, Greater London
